economy.summary: His campaign site supports raising the minimum wage to reflect the real cost of living and partnering with local businesses to bring economic opportunity to Armstrong and Westmoreland counties. In a VOTE411 questionnaire he named housing and food costs, jobs, and deteriorating infrastructure as the district's most pressing issues.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage; names housing costs, jobs, infrastructure.

taxes.summary: His campaign site supports passing revenue-generating legislation, naming recreational marijuana and 'Games of Skill' taxation, and supports holding legislators financially accountable when state budgets are not passed on time.
taxes.short: Supports marijuana and games-of-skill taxation; legislator accountability on budgets.

education.summary: His campaign site calls for ensuring public schools are adequately and fairly funded, regardless of zip code.
education.short: Calls for adequate, fair public school funding regardless of zip code.

energy.summary: His campaign site proposes remediating brownfield industrial sites, continuing work on abandoned mine drainage affecting local waterways, addressing shallow land nuclear disposal sites with federal partners, and halting new data center construction until independent environmental impact studies are completed.
energy.short: Proposes brownfield and mine-drainage cleanup; halt data centers pending studies.

economy.summary: As the incumbent, she is the prime sponsor of HB 2396, a bill providing consumer fuel price relief through a state gas and diesel tax holiday; the accompanying memo describes a six-month suspension with retailers required to pass the savings on at the pump.
economy.short: Sponsors gas tax holiday bill for consumer fuel price relief.

taxes.summary: Her campaign site says she will cut wasteful spending and oppose higher taxes so working families keep more of their money.
taxes.short: Says she will cut wasteful spending and oppose higher taxes.

abortion.summary: Her campaign site pledges to defend pro-life values; it does not detail specific abortion legislation.
abortion.short: Pledges to defend pro-life values; no specifics given.

education.summary: Her campaign site lists quality schools among what she says families deserve; it does not detail specific education policy.
education.short: Lists quality schools as a priority; no policy detail.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign site lists affordable health care among what she says families deserve; it does not detail specific healthcare policy.
healthcare.short: Lists affordable health care as a priority; no policy detail.

guns.summary: Her campaign site says she will defend the Second Amendment and protect residents' constitutional rights; her official House site also lists protecting Second Amendment rights as a legislative focus.
guns.short: Says she will defend Second Amendment rights.
